notes: Hybrid release: classic Lo Shu Foundation (Birth, Name and Combined grids) as the primary remedy blueprint, Vedic Ank Kundali retained as a birth-only Planetary Strength Indicator, the independent proportional Ank Jyotish Dasha / active Vastu timeline, the additive Classical Vimshottari layer anchored on the natal Moon nakshatra, a client-selected Scaled Sadhana practice depth (Beginner 11x / Practitioner-Sadhak 27x / Classical 108x) plus an upfront Ethical & Health Notice inside the Northstar Summary, and a complete partner-Moon stack — Chandra-bala (Rashi axis), Astro-Identity positions, partner Vimshottari and Nakshatra-level Tara Bala. New in app 2.12.0: partner intake now captures optional birth time & place (same offline atlas), computes the partner's sidereal Moon via the on-device Meeus engine, reports the 1/1 to 7/7 Rashi axis with shared-lord note, shows both charts' Sun/Moon/Nakshatra/Lagna positions, the partner's own Vimshottari anchor & active MD/AD/PD with factual same-lord comparison, and a Tara Bala layer counting nakshatras both ways modulo 9 (3/5/7 inauspicious). Pack stays 2.9.0 (app logic only). Previous 2.11.0: wealth & business windows 21–75 (career 70, property 75, abroad 60, marriage 45), 80-year Dasha horizon, lifetime coverage line.
